methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Handshake: negotiate version, pass config; server replies with contributions.

methods.name: tool/call
methods.description: Invoke a tool the server declared.

methods.name: tool/update
methods.description: Notification: streamed progress for an in-flight tool/call (correlated by request_id).

methods.name: status/changed
methods.description: Notification: a short capability status the host surfaces in its status bar (empty status clears it).

methods.name: prompt/contribution
methods.description: Request a fresh dynamic system-prompt contribution.

methods.name: command/execute
methods.description: Run a manifest-declared slash command; the result message is shown to the user.

methods.name: config/changed
methods.description: Notify the server its config changed.
